implementation_summary: history/ module: createHistoryBackend({handlers, store?, settleTimeoutMs?, onError?}) returns the library HistoryBackend plus sweep(). Rows {entry, seq, dispatched} live in idb store few-group-history (get/set/del/delMany/keys/entries/createStore only, lazy creation) with per-group counter rows; append writes the row undispatched, dispatches via the injected GroupHistoryHandlers port with sender=orderingKey.account, then rewrites dispatched:true. Every call is serialised per group and bounded to 10 s (timed-out call is abandoned and writes nothing). withdraw retracts then deletes per existing row (unknown id no-op, no tombstone); purge deletes the group's rows and counter; list sorts by seq; sweep re-dispatches undispatched rows per group in seq order, continuing past failures. Rumor kinds outside APP_RUMOR_KINDS are stored dispatched:true without handler calls (AppKinds seam). Gate remediation (2026-11-17): per-group first-touch recovery inside the serialised job (touched set per instance), sweep() recovers untouched groups, persisted recoveryFailures with abandonment at 5, per-(groupId,eventId) in-flight dispatch map; bootstrap runs history.sweep() after groups.list() and before inbox.start() (rejection reported as step historySweep, non-fatal).

verification.unit_full: make test-unit: 306 files, 6785 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed

decisions: Recovery continues past a failing row within a group and across groups; failures go to onError and SweepResult.failed; a row is abandoned after 5 persisted failed recoveries.
withdraw retracts BEFORE deleting the row, so a failed retract is retried with the row still present; withdraw of an unknown id keeps no tombstone (AC-WDR-4).
Sink gates dispatch/retract on APP_RUMOR_KINDS: unregistered kinds are stored dispatched:true with no handler call.
Store is injectable (createIdbHistoryStore(dbName)) so harness peers in one process get isolated databases; default is the lazy few-group-history singleton.
Added clearAllGroupHistory() for clearAllGroupData / storeIncompatible wipe.
Harness keeps its own partitionable() copy instead of importing testHooks/groupLibrary, which S27 deletes.
limitations: AC-WDR-5 harness uses 2 members: the abandoned message is the loser's own confirmed message (spec A3 amendment); withdrawal of another member's message is covered at unit level only (a 3-member fork would be needed).
seq counter is get-then-set serialised in-process; relies on the single-writer account lease.
Sink wiring into the app (concrete handlers S4/S5, call sites S18); bootstrap already runs history.sweep() after groups.list().
After a dispatch timeout a LATER entry's dispatch may overlap a still-running earlier one; handlers for dependent kinds (5/7/10-12) must tolerate a missing target.
Entries of unregistered kinds are stored dispatched:true permanently and are not replayed if the kind is registered later.

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The ledger note said a handler-enqueued job shows up as a queuedJob reentrant error, but the library guard only rejects group writes (send/rename); reads from the job succeed, so the first harness attempt using keyPackages.count() silently passed. Needed a probe to find the right call.
